verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: There is no scientific evidence linking 5G mobile technology to the coronavirus. COVID-19 is a disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, which is transmitted between people, not through radio waves.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple independent fact-checking organizations, including AP News, AFP Fact Check, and Full Fact, have debunked this claim. Scientific consensus confirms that COVID-19 is caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus and spreads through respiratory droplets, not through radio waves from 5G technology. Investigations have found no correlation between the rollout of 5G networks and the incidence of COVID-19 cases.
